name: The Decree
storyline:
The Sisters are bound to a mysterious Decree: hunt wandering souls throughout a cursed city and collect enough to fulfill each Order before the clock runs out.

Every soul has value, but capturing them becomes increasingly difficult. As the Sisters hunt, Soul Drainers emerge and threaten to derail the Order.

Then sometimes, The Button appears.

A situation is presented. The Sisters must choose between PROCEED and STAY without knowing what either choice will cause. The consequences are revealed only after the decision is made.

Complete the Orders, survive the escalating pressure, and decide how far you are willing to push the run before extracting.
summary:
The Decree is a 1–3 player cooperative horror game about hunting souls, surviving a relentless 90-second clock, and making impossible choices when The Button appears.

Track wandering souls, capture them under pressure, fight Soul Drainers, and fulfill each Order before time runs out.

When The Button appears, choose PROCEED or STAY without knowing what either choice will cause.

Push your run further, survive the Orders, and decide when to extract—or keep going until the Decree breaks you.
